title: What Guests Say
why: Proof for warm leads: real Google review lines about rain, night sessions, the social vibe, and the plunge.
hook_options: What people say after the river.
caption: A few lines from our Google reviews that say it better than we could. Rainy days, night sessions, strangers being kind, and the cold that feels good after. First names only. #EbbAndEmber #PortlandSauna #FloatingSauna #ColdPlunge

slides.headline: Straight from our Google reviews.
slides.body: We'd rather let guests describe it. Here are the lines we keep rereading.

slides.headline: "Watching the rain hit the river."
slides.body: "Such a perfect spot to sit and soak in the heat while watching the rain hit the river through the huge windows."

slides.headline: Big windows, river level.
slides.body: The benches face the Columbia, so the weather becomes the view.

slides.headline: "Going at night is the way to go."
slides.body: "You can see the dock lights reflecting on the river."

slides.headline: Night sessions run on dock lights.
slides.body: Lit windows, black water, steam rolling off your shoulders on the deck.

slides.headline: "Welcoming from the moment we walked up."
slides.body: "We did the social sauna and it was nice how welcoming everyone was from the moment we walked up."

slides.headline: Up to 8 guests. Room to talk.
slides.body: Small enough for real conversation. Big enough to meet someone new.

slides.headline: "A sauna on the river!"
slides.body: "I celebrated my anniversary here tonight. Epic views at sunset. Showers. Cold water to jump in right in the river."

slides.headline: "It felt so amazing once you got out."
slides.body: "It's not easy to make yourself jump into freezing cold water, but it felt so amazing once you got out."

slides.headline: Come write your own.
slides.body: Book at ebbandember.com. Then tell us how the river felt.
